headline: Ophydia planting
title: Ophydia | The Planting Level Seven Dragon | Palworld Guide
video_script: Ophydia is a Grass and Water dragon in Palworld one point zero with some of the best farm work around. It has Planting level seven and Watering level five. It can be ridden, and its partner skill, Glorious Mist, makes your attacks build up Soak while it is in your party. An alpha is found in Waterlily Gorge. Electric attacks hit it hard. Do you farm a lot? Comment below!
description: Ophydia in Palworld 1.0 is a rideable Grass and Water Pal with Planting level seven and the Glorious Mist partner skill.
